nodes.title: Grid convergence index on the hover film coefficient (fine grid)
nodes.how: Re-run esc_cfd.py mesh/run/summary; three levels L1-L3. An L4 (~150 k cells) would tighten it.
nodes.note: h rises monotonically with refinement, so the fine-grid and lower-band values used for design are on the cool side of the converged answer; limit 15 % = E3 acceptance for a design input carried with the lower band

nodes.title: Grid convergence index on the cruise film coefficient (fine grid)
Local-velocity factor the lumped ESC model needs to reproduce the CFD film
nodes.equation: h_lam(fU) = 0.664 (f U L/nu)^0.5 Pr^1/3 k/L  =>  f = (h / h_lam(U))^2 ; model factor k_m = h_SA / h_SST (hover, L2) ; design = min(SST lower GCI band, LM Tu 1 %, k_m x SST L2) per regime (the lowest of the three turbulence models on the same grid) ; nominal = SST extrapolated

nodes.title: ESC local-velocity factor from CFD [hover design, cruise design, hover nominal, cruise nominal]
nodes.how: T-E3-ESC-PAD back-solves f = (h_meas / h_lam(U))^2; pass if f_meas >= the design value.
nodes.note: replaces the judged ASM-E3-WAKE (0.5 design / 0.7 nominal) in thermal.py R3

nodes.title: ESC film coefficient on the half-fin mock-up (validates the CFD)
nodes.procedure: As T-E3-ESC-PAD: foam-board half-fin with the 22 mm tube and the ASA pad behind the stand prop at hover power; ESC replaced by a 45 x 20 x 6 mm aluminium dummy with a 3 W resistor and a thermocouple; steady rise -> h. Pass: f_meas >= design value of CL-E3-CFD-FEQ.
